reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Calibrated forced reverse gamma rotation in isolated F1 with ADP/phosphate and direct ATP measurement; motion, direction, enzyme and analytical controls.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.

checks.quote: ATP detection not eliminated by apyrase/hexokinase
checks.reason: Genuine contaminating ATP is also consumed by apyrase or hexokinase. Resistance to those treatments can flag non-ATP assay signal, not characterize ATP contamination as stated.
Independent matrix standards, recovery and mechanics checks are present, but no objective acceptance rule (or procedure deriving it) and failure action gates the chemical/mechanical calibration.

checks.quote: random effects for preparation and bead
checks.reason: Chemical fractions are chamber-level outputs, but the model uses beads as random replicates without specifying separate chemical compartments/chambers; no pilot-variance/precision or power justification fixes confirmatory replication.
Prospective quality review is proposed, but operational exclusion thresholds, stopping policy and complete technical attrition versus biological nonresponse accounting are not specified.
Primary comparisons are named, but interval construction/model checking and multiplicity handling for the directional/control comparisons are not operationally specified.
Pilot ranges or variables are supplied, but no complete bounded exploration and objective setting-selection/lock before independent confirmation.
No explicit revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after failed/ambiguous exploratory work.

checks.quote: Primary endpoint is 32Pi incorporation into ATP.
checks.reason: Isotopic phosphate incorporation alone can represent exchange with initially bound ATP. Total ATP is also measured, but no initial device/protein-bound inventory and net mass-balance decision excludes exchange plus release. The negative rule uses non-significance without an adequately precise bound.
No complete preparation/chamber/raw-trajectory/chemical-sample/calibration manifest linked to analysis versions/settings, deviations and outputs.

However, the primary decision does not establish repeated net synthesis beyond bound inventory, and contamination specificity and chemical replication need correction.
